title: Kissed Crispy Chinese Scallion Pancakes
description: A briny and crispy Chinese dish featuring dijon mustard and score-fat, cooked to perfection on a raclette grill, this scallion pancake is a festive treat for any meal, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients for a balanced diet.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt to make the dough.
Add dijon mustard, score-fat, and chopped scallions to the bowl and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Gradually add water to the dough and knead for about 10 minutes until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a thin circle.
Brush the raclette grill with a small amount of score-fat and heat it to medium-high heat.
Place a dough circle on the grill and cook for about 2 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining dough pieces.
Sprinkle the cooked pancakes with sesame seeds and black pepper if desired.
Serve the scallion pancakes hot and enjoy.
